'''Confidence of the Dead End''' was a phrase [[Candra Kitai]] used which meant that when someone had nothing to lose, they would have nothing to fear.

[[Orielle Kitai]] thought of her mother's phrase when thinking about the poor [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] [[Jelph Marrian]] as he was loading her [[uvak]], [[Shyn]], with [[dalsa flower]]s.
